title: Is settler violence Israeli policy or extremism — and will a new leader bring change?
summary_full: Netanyahu supporters blame radicals and “drug-addled teens” for attacks eroding Palestinian self-rule. Others see “state violence” and hope Gadi Eisenkot has an answer.
